passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.1
passages.text: Sic fatur lacrimans, classique immittit habenas,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.2
passages.text: et tandem Euboïcis Cumarum adlabitur oris.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.3
passages.text: Obvertunt pelago proras; tum dente tenaci

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.4
passages.text: ancora fundabat naves, et litora curvae

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.5
passages.text: praetexunt puppes. Iuvenum manus emicat ardens

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.6
passages.text: litus in Hesperium; quaerit pars semina flammae

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.7
passages.text: abstrusa in venis silicis, pars densa ferarum

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.8
passages.text: tecta rapit silvas, inventaque flumina monstrat.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.9
passages.text: At pius Aeneas arces, quibus altus Apollo

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.10
passages.text: praesidet, horrendaeque procul secreta Sibyllae

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.11
passages.text: antrum immane petit, magnum cui mentem animumque

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.12
passages.text: Delius inspirat vates, aperitque futura.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.13
passages.text: Iam subeunt Triviae lucos atque aurea tecta.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.14
passages.text: Daedalus, ut fama est, fugiens Minoïa regna,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.15
passages.text: praepetibus pennis ausus se credere caelo,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.16
passages.text: insuetum per iter gelidas enavit ad Arctos,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.17
passages.text: Chalcidicaque levis tandem super adstitit arce.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.18
passages.text: Redditus his primum terris, tibi, Phoebe, sacravit

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.19
passages.text: remigium alarum, posuitque immania templa.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.20
passages.text: In foribus letum Androgeo: tum pendere poenas

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.21
passages.text: Cecropidae iussi—miserum!—septena quotannis

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.22
passages.text: corpora natorum; stat ductis sortibus urna.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.23
passages.text: Contra elata mari respondet Gnosia tellus:

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.24
passages.text: hic crudelis amor tauri, suppostaque furto

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.25
passages.text: Pasiphaë, mixtumque genus prolesque biformis

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.26
passages.text: Minotaurus inest, Veneris monumenta nefandae;

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.27
passages.text: hic labor ille domus et inextricabilis error;

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.28
passages.text: magnum reginae sed enim miseratus amorem

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.29
passages.text: Daedalus ipse dolos tecti ambagesque resolvit,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.30
passages.text: caeca regens filo vestigia. Tu quoque magnam

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.31
passages.text: partem opere in tanto, sineret dolor, Icare, haberes.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.32
passages.text: Bis conatus erat casus effingere in auro;

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.33
passages.text: bis patriae cecidere manus. Quin protinus omnia

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.34
passages.text: perlegerent oculis, ni iam praemissus Achates

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.35
passages.text: adforet, atque una Phoebi Triviaeque sacerdos,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.36
passages.text: Deiphobe Glauci, fatur quae talia regi:

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.37
passages.text: Non hoc ista sibi tempus spectacula poscit;

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.38
passages.text: nunc grege de intacto septem mactare iuvencos

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.39
passages.text: praestiterit, totidem lectas de more bidentes.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.40
passages.text: Talibus adfata Aenean (nec sacra morantur

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.41
passages.text: iussa viri), Teucros vocat alta in templa sacerdos.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.42
passages.text: Excisum Euboicae latus ingens rupis in antrum,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.43
passages.text: quo lati ducunt aditus centum, ostia centum;

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.44
passages.text: unde ruunt totidem voces, responsa Sibyllae.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.45
passages.text: Ventum erat ad limen, cum virgo. Poscere fata

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.46
passages.text: tempus ait; deus, ecce, deus! Cui talia fanti

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.47
passages.text: ante fores subito non voltus, non color unus,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.48
passages.text: non comptae mansere comae; sed pectus anhelum,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.49
passages.text: et rabie fera corda tument; maiorque videri,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.50
passages.text: nec mortale sonans, adflata est numine quando

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.51
passages.text: iam propiore dei. Cessas in vota precesque,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.52
passages.text: Tros ait Aenea? Cessas? Neque enim ante dehiscent

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.53
passages.text: attonitae magna ora domus. Et talia fata

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.54
passages.text: conticuit. Gelidus Teucris per dura cucurrit

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.55
passages.text: ossa tremor, funditque preces rex pectore ab imo:

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.56
passages.text: Phoebe, graves Troiae semper miserate labores,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.57
passages.text: Dardana qui Paridis direxti tela manusque

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.58
passages.text: corpus in Aeacidae, magnas obeuntia terras

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.59
passages.text: tot maria intravi duce te, penitusque repostas

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.60
passages.text: Massylum gentes praetentaque Syrtibus arva,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.61
passages.text: iam tandem Italiae fugientis prendimus oras;

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.62
passages.text: hac Troiana tenus fuerit Fortuna secuta.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.63
passages.text: Vos quoque Pergameae iam fas est parcere genti,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.64
passages.text: dique deaeque omnes quibus obstitit Ilium et ingens

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.65
passages.text: gloria Dardaniae. Tuque, O sanctissima vates,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.66
passages.text: praescia venturi, da, non indebita posco

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.67
passages.text: regna meis fatis, Latio considere Teucros

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.68
passages.text: errantisque deos agitataque numina Troiae.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.69
passages.text: Tum Phoebo et Triviae solido de marmore templum

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.70
passages.text: instituam, festosque dies de nomine Phoebi.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.71
passages.text: Te quoque magna manent regnis penetralia nostris:

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.72
passages.text: hic ego namque tuas sortes arcanaque fata,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.73
passages.text: dicta meae genti, ponam, lectosque sacrabo,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.74
passages.text: alma, viros. Foliis tantum ne carmina manda,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.75
passages.text: ne turbata volent rapidis ludibria ventis;

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.76
passages.text: ipsa canas oro. Finem dedit ore loquendi.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.77
passages.text: At, Phoebi nondum patiens, immanis in antro

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.78
passages.text: bacchatur vates, magnum si pectore possit

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.79
passages.text: excussisse deum; tanto magis ille fatigat

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.80
passages.text: os rabidum, fera corda domans, fingitque premendo.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.81
passages.text: Ostia iamque domus patuere ingentia centum

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.82
passages.text: sponte sua, vatisque ferunt responsa per auras:

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.83
passages.text: O tandem magnis pelagi defuncte periclis!

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.84
passages.text: Sed terrae graviora manent. In regna Lavini

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.85
passages.text: Dardanidae venient; mitte hanc de pectore curam;

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.86
passages.text: sed non et venisse volent. Bella, horrida bella,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.87
passages.text: et Thybrim multo spumantem sanguine cerno.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.88
passages.text: Non Simois tibi, nec Xanthus, nec Dorica castra

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.89
passages.text: defuerint; alius Latio iam partus Achilles,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.90
passages.text: natus et ipse dea; nec Teucris addita Iuno

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.91
passages.text: usquam aberit; cum tu supplex in rebus egenis

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.92
passages.text: quas gentes Italum aut quas non oraveris urbes!

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.93
passages.text: Causa mali tanti coniunx iterum hospita Teucris

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.94
passages.text: externique iterum thalami.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.95
passages.text: Tu ne cede malis, sed contra audentior ito,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.96
passages.text: qua tua te Fortuna sinet. Via prima salutis,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.97
passages.text: quod minime reris, Graia pandetur ab urbe.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.98
passages.text: Talibus ex adyto dictis Cumaea Sibylla

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.99
passages.text: horrendas canit ambages antroque remugit,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.100
passages.text: obscuris vera involvens: ea frena furenti

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.101
passages.text: concutit, et stimulos sub pectore vertit Apollo.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.102
passages.text: Ut primum cessit furor et rabida ora quierunt,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.103
passages.text: incipit Aeneas heros: Non ulla laborum,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.104
passages.text: O virgo, nova mi facies inopinave surgit;

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.105
passages.text: omnia praecepi atque animo mecum ante peregi.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.106
passages.text: Unum oro: quando hic inferni ianua regis

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.107
passages.text: dicitur, et tenebrosa palus Acheronte refuso,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.108
passages.text: ire ad conspectum cari genitoris et ora

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.109
passages.text: contingat; doceas iter et sacra ostia pandas.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.110
passages.text: Illum ego per flammas et mille sequentia tela

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.111
passages.text: eripui his umeris, medioque ex hoste recepi;

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.112
passages.text: ille meum comitatus iter, maria omnia mecum

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.113
passages.text: atque omnes pelagique minas caelique ferebat,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.114
passages.text: invalidus, vires ultra sortemque senectae.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.115
passages.text: Quin, ut te supplex peterem et tua limina adirem,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.116
passages.text: idem orans mandata dabat. Gnatique patrisque,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.117
passages.text: alma, precor, miserere;—potes namque omnia, nec te

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.118
passages.text: nequiquam lucis Hecate praefecit Avernis;—

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.119
passages.text: si potuit Manes arcessere coniugis Orpheus,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.120
passages.text: Threïcia fretus cithara fidibusque canoris,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.121
passages.text: si fratrem Pollux alterna morte redemit,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.122
passages.text: itque reditque viam totiens. Quid Thesea, magnum

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.123
passages.text: quid memorem Alciden? Et mi genus ab Iove summo.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.124
passages.text: Talibus orabat dictis, arasque tenebat,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.125
passages.text: cum sic orsa loqui vates: Sate sanguine divom,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.126
passages.text: Tros Anchisiade, facilis descensus Averno;

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.127
passages.text: noctes atque dies patet atri ianua Ditis;

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.128
passages.text: sed revocare gradum superasque evadere ad auras,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.129
passages.text: hoc opus, hic labor est. Pauci, quos aequus amavit

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.130
passages.text: Iuppiter, aut ardens evexit ad aethera virtus,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.131
passages.text: dis geniti potuere. Tenent media omnia silvae,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.132
passages.text: Cocytusque sinu labens circumvenit atro.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.133
passages.text: Quod si tantus amor menti, si tanta cupido est,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.134
passages.text: bis Stygios innare lacus, bis nigra videre

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.135
passages.text: Tartara, et insano iuvat indulgere labori,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.136
passages.text: accipe, quae peragenda prius. Latet arbore opaca

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.137
passages.text: aureus et foliis et lento vimine ramus,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.138
passages.text: Iunoni infernae dictus sacer; hunc tegit omnis

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.139
passages.text: lucus, et obscuris claudunt convallibus umbrae.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.140
passages.text: Sed non ante datur telluris operta subire,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.141
passages.text: auricomos quam quis decerpserit arbore fetus.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.142
passages.text: Hoc sibi pulchra suum ferri Proserpina munus

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.143
passages.text: instituit. Primo avulso non deficit alter

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.144
passages.text: aureus, et simili frondescit virga metallo.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.145
passages.text: Ergo alte vestiga oculis, et rite repertum

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.146
passages.text: carpe manu; namque ipse volens facilisque sequetur,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.147
passages.text: si te fata vocant; aliter non viribus ullis

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.148
passages.text: vincere, nec duro poteris convellere ferro.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.149
passages.text: Praeterea iacet exanimum tibi corpus amici—

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.150
passages.text: heu nescis—totamque incestat funere classem,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.151
passages.text: dum consulta petis nostroque in limine pendes.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.152
passages.text: Sedibus hunc refer ante suis et conde sepulchro.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.153
passages.text: Duc nigras pecudes; ea prima piacula sunto:

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.154
passages.text: sic demum lucos Stygis et regna invia vivis

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.155
passages.text: aspicies. Dixit, pressoque obmutuit ore.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.156
passages.text: Aeneas maesto defixus lumina voltu

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.157
passages.text: ingreditur, linquens antrum, caecosque volutat

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.158
passages.text: eventus animo secum. Cui fidus Achates

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.159
passages.text: it comes, et paribus curis vestigia figit.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.160
passages.text: Multa inter sese vario sermone serebant,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.161
passages.text: quem socium exanimem vates, quod corpus humandum

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.162
passages.text: diceret. Atque illi Misenum in litore sicco,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.163
passages.text: ut venere, vident indigna morte peremptum,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.164
passages.text: Misenum Aeoliden, quo non praestantior alter

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.165
passages.text: aere ciere viros, Martemque accendere cantu.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.166
passages.text: Hectoris hic magni fuerat comes, Hectora circum

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.167
passages.text: et lituo pugnas insignis obibat et hasta:

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.168
passages.text: postquam illum vita victor spoliavit Achilles,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.169
passages.text: Dardanio Aeneae sese fortissimus heros

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.170
passages.text: addiderat socium, non inferiora secutus.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.171
passages.text: Sed tum, forte cava dum personat aequora concha,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.172
passages.text: demens, et cantu vocat in certamina divos,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.173
passages.text: aemulus exceptum Triton, si credere dignum est,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.174
passages.text: inter saxa virum spumosa inmerserat unda.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.175
passages.text: Ergo omnes magno circum clamore fremebant,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.176
passages.text: praecipue pius Aeneas. Tum iussa Sibyllae,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.177
passages.text: haud mora, festinant flentes, aramque sepulchri

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.178
passages.text: congerere arboribus caeloque educere certant.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.179
passages.text: Itur in antiquam silvam, stabula alta ferarum;

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.180
passages.text: procumbunt piceae, sonat icta securibus ilex,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.181
passages.text: fraxineaeque trabes cuneis et fissile robur

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.182
passages.text: scinditur, advolvunt ingentis montibus ornos.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.183
passages.text: Nec non Aeneas opera inter talia primus

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.184
passages.text: hortatur socios, paribusque accingitur armis.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.185
passages.text: Atque haec ipse suo tristi cum corde volutat,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.186
passages.text: aspectans silvam inmensam, et sic voce precatur:

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.187
passages.text: Si nunc se nobis ille aureus arbore ramus

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.188
passages.text: ostendat nemore in tanto, quando omnia vere

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.189
passages.text: heu nimium de te vates, Misene, locuta est.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.190
passages.text: Vix ea fatus erat, geminae cum forte columbae

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.191
passages.text: ipsa sub ora viri caelo venere volantes,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.192
passages.text: et viridi sedere solo. Tum maximus heros

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.193
passages.text: maternas agnoscit aves, laetusque precatur:

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.194
passages.text: Este duces, O, si qua via est, cursumque per auras

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.195
passages.text: dirigite in lucos, ubi pinguem dives opacat

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.196
passages.text: ramus humum. Tuque, O, dubiis ne defice rebus,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.197
passages.text: diva parens. Sic effatus vestigia pressit,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.198
passages.text: observans quae signa ferant, quo tendere pergant.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.199
passages.text: Pascentes illae tantum prodire volando,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.200
passages.text: quantum acie possent oculi servare sequentum.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.201
passages.text: Inde ubi venere ad fauces grave olentis Averni,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.202
passages.text: tollunt se celeres, liquidumque per aëra lapsae

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.203
passages.text: sedibus optatis geminae super arbore sidunt,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.204
passages.text: discolor unde auri per ramos aura refulsit.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.205
passages.text: Quale solet silvis brumali frigore viscum

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.206
passages.text: fronde virere nova, quod non sua seminat arbos,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.207
passages.text: et croceo fetu teretis circumdare truncos,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.208
passages.text: talis erat species auri frondentis opaca

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.209
passages.text: ilice, sic leni crepitabat brattea vento.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.210
passages.text: Corripit Aeneas extemplo avidusque refringit

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.211
passages.text: cunctantem, et vatis portat sub tecta Sibyllae.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.212
passages.text: Nec minus interea Misenum in litore Teucri

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.213
passages.text: flebant, et cineri ingrato suprema ferebant.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.214
passages.text: Principio pinguem taedis et robore secto

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.215
passages.text: ingentem struxere pyram, cui frondibus atris

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.216
passages.text: intexunt latera, et ferales ante cupressos

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.217
passages.text: constituunt, decorantque super fulgentibus armis.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.218
passages.text: Pars calidos latices et aëna undantia flammis

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.219
passages.text: expediunt, corpusque lavant frigentis et unguunt.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.220
passages.text: Fit gemitus. Tum membra toro defleta reponunt,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.221
passages.text: purpureasque super vestes, velamina nota,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.222
passages.text: coniciunt. Pars ingenti subiere feretro,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.223
passages.text: triste ministerium, et subiectam more parentum

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.224
passages.text: aversi tenuere facem. Congesta cremantur

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.225
passages.text: turea dona, dapes, fuso crateres olivo.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.226
passages.text: Postquam conlapsi cineres et flamma quievit

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.227
passages.text: reliquias vino et bibulam lavere favillam,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.228
passages.text: ossaque lecta cado texit Corynaeus aëno.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.229
passages.text: Idem ter socios pura circumtulit unda,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.230
passages.text: spargens rore levi et ramo felicis olivae,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.231
passages.text: lustravitque viros, dixitque novissima verba.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.232
passages.text: At pius Aeneas ingenti mole sepulcrum

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.233
passages.text: imponit, suaque arma viro, remumque tubamque,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.234
passages.text: monte sub aërio, qui nunc Misenus ab illo

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.235
passages.text: dicitur, aeternumque tenet per saecula nomen.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.236
passages.text: His actis, propere exsequitur praecepta Sibyllae.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.237
passages.text: Spelunca alta fuit vastoque immanis hiatu,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.238
passages.text: scrupea, tuta lacu nigro nemorumque tenebris,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.239
passages.text: quam super haud ullae poterant impune volantes

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.240
passages.text: tendere iter pennis—talis sese halitus atris

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.241
passages.text: faucibus effundens supera ad convexa ferebat:

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.243
passages.text: quattuor hic primum nigrantis terga iuvencos

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.244
passages.text: constituit, frontique invergit vina sacerdos;

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.245
passages.text: et summas carpens media inter cornua saetas

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.246
passages.text: ignibus imponit sacris, libamina prima,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.247
passages.text: voce vocans Hecaten, Caeloque Ereboque potentem.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.248
passages.text: Supponunt alii cultros, tepidumque cruorem

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.249
passages.text: suscipiunt pateris. Ipse atri velleris agnam

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.250
passages.text: Aeneas matri Eumenidum magnaeque sorori

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.251
passages.text: ense ferit, sterilemque tibi. Proserpina, vaccam.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.252
passages.text: Tum Stygio regi nocturnas inchoat aras,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.253
passages.text: et solida imponit taurorum viscera flammis,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.254
passages.text: pingue superque oleum infundens ardentibus extis.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.255
passages.text: Ecce autem, primi sub lumina solis et ortus,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.256
passages.text: sub pedibus mugire solum, et iuga coepta moveri

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.257
passages.text: silvarum, visaeque canes ululare per umbram,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.258
passages.text: adventante dea. Procul O procul este, profani,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.259
passages.text: conclamat vates, totoque absistite luco;

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.260
passages.text: tuque invade viam, vaginaque eripe ferrum:

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.261
passages.text: nunc animis opus, Aenea, nunc pectore firmo.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.262
passages.text: Tantum effata, furens antro se immisit aperto;

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.263
passages.text: ille ducem haud timidis vadentem passibus aequat.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.264
passages.text: Di, quibus imperium est animarum, umbraeque silentes,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.265
passages.text: et Chaos, et Phlegethon, loca nocte tacentia late,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.266
passages.text: sit mihi fas audita loqui; sit numine vestro

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.267
passages.text: pandere res alta terra et caligine mersas!

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.268
passages.text: Ibant obscuri sola sub nocte per umbram,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.269
passages.text: perque domos Ditis vacuas et inania regna:

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.270
passages.text: quale per incertam lunam sub luce maligna

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.271
passages.text: est iter in silvis, ubi caelum condidit umbra

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.272
passages.text: Iuppiter, et rebus nox abstulit atra colorem.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.273
passages.text: Vestibulum ante ipsum, primisque in faucibus Orci

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.274
passages.text: Luctus et ultrices posuere cubilia Curae;

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.275
passages.text: pallentesque habitant Morbi, tristisque Senectus,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.276
passages.text: et Metus, et malesuada Fames, ac turpis Egestas,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.277
passages.text: terribiles visu formae: Letumque, Labosque;

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.278
passages.text: tum consanguineus Leti Sopor, et mala mentis

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.279
passages.text: Gaudia, mortiferumque adverso in limine Bellum,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.280
passages.text: ferreique Eumenidum thalami, et Discordia demens,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.281
passages.text: vipereum crinem vittis innexa cruentis.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.282
passages.text: In medio ramos annosaque brachia pandit

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.283
passages.text: ulmus opaca, ingens, quam sedem Somnia volgo

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.284
passages.text: vana tenere ferunt, foliisque sub omnibus haerent.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.285
passages.text: Multaque praeterea variarum monstra ferarum:

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.286
passages.text: Centauri in foribus stabulant, Scyllaeque biformes,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.287
passages.text: et centumgeminus Briareus, ac belua Lernae

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.288
passages.text: horrendum stridens, flammisque armata Chimaera,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.289
passages.text: Gorgones Harpyiaeque et forma tricorporis umbrae.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.290
passages.text: Corripit hic subita trepidus formidine ferrum

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.291
passages.text: Aeneas, strictamque aciem venientibus offert,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.292
passages.text: et, ni docta comes tenues sine corpore vitas

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.293
passages.text: admoneat volitare cava sub imagine formae,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.294
passages.text: inruat, et frustra ferro diverberet umbras.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.295
passages.text: Hinc via, Tartarei quae fert Acherontis ad undas.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.296
passages.text: Turbidus hic caeno vastaque voragine gurges

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.297
passages.text: aestuat, atque omnem Cocyto eructat harenam.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.298
passages.text: Portitor has horrendus aquas et flumina servat

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.299
passages.text: terribili squalore Charon, cui plurima mento

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.300
passages.text: canities inculta iacet; stant lumina flamma,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.301
passages.text: sordidus ex umeris nodo dependet amictus.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.302
passages.text: Ipse ratem conto subigit, velisque ministrat,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.303
passages.text: et ferruginea subvectat corpora cymba,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.304
passages.text: iam senior, sed cruda deo viridisque senectus.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.305
passages.text: Huc omnis turba ad ripas effusa ruebat,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.306
passages.text: matres atque viri, defunctaque corpora vita

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.307
passages.text: magnanimum heroum, pueri innuptaeque puellae,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.308
passages.text: impositique rogis iuvenes ante ora parentum:

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.309
passages.text: quam multa in silvis autumni frigore primo

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.310
passages.text: lapsa cadunt folia, aut ad terram gurgite ab alto

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.311
passages.text: quam multae glomerantur aves, ubi frigidus annus

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.312
passages.text: trans pontum fugat, et terris immittit apricis.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.313
passages.text: Stabant orantes primi transmittere cursum,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.314
passages.text: tendebantque manus ripae ulterioris amore.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.315
passages.text: Navita sed tristis nunc hos nunc accipit illos,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.316
passages.text: ast alios longe submotos arcet harena.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.317
passages.text: Aeneas, miratus enim motusque tumultu,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.318
passages.text: Dic ait O virgo, quid volt concursus ad amnem?

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.319
passages.text: Quidve petunt animae, vel quo discrimine ripas

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.320
passages.text: hae linquunt, illae remis vada livida verrunt?

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.321
passages.text: Olli sic breviter fata est longaeva sacerdos:

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.322
passages.text: Anchisa generate, deum certissima proles,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.323
passages.text: Cocyti stagna alta vides Stygiamque paludem,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.324
passages.text: di cuius iurare timent et fallere numen.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.325
passages.text: Haec omnis, quam cernis, inops inhumataque turba est;

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.326
passages.text: portitor ille Charon; hi, quos vehit unda, sepulti.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.327
passages.text: Nec ripas datur horrendas et rauca fluenta

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.328
passages.text: transportare prius quam sedibus ossa quierunt.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.329
passages.text: Centum errant annos volitantque haec litora circum;

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.330
passages.text: tum demum admissi stagna exoptata revisunt.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.331
passages.text: Constitit Anchisa satus et vestigia pressit,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.332
passages.text: multa putans, sortemque animo miseratus iniquam.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.333
passages.text: Cernit ibi maestos et mortis honore carentes

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.334
passages.text: Leucaspim et Lyciae ductorem classis Oronten,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.335
passages.text: quos, simul ab Troia ventosa per aequora vectos,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.336
passages.text: obruit Auster, aqua involvens navemque virosque.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.337
passages.text: Ecce gubernator sese Palinurus agebat,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.338
passages.text: qui Libyco nuper cursu, dum sidera servat,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.339
passages.text: exciderat puppi mediis effusus in undis.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.340
passages.text: Hunc ubi vix multa maestum cognovit in umbra,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.341
passages.text: sic prior adloquitur: Quis te, Palinure, deorum

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.342
passages.text: eripuit nobis, medioque sub aequore mersit?

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.343
passages.text: Dic age. Namque mihi, fallax haud ante repertus,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.344
passages.text: hoc uno responso animum delusit Apollo,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.345
passages.text: qui fore te ponto incolumem, finesque canebat

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.346
passages.text: venturum Ausonios. En haec promissa fides est?

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.347
passages.text: Ille autem: Neque te Phoebi cortina fefellit,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.348
passages.text: dux Anchisiade, nec me deus aequore mersit.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.349
passages.text: Namque gubernaclum multa vi forte revolsum,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.350
passages.text: cui datus haerebam custos cursusque regebam,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.351
passages.text: praecipitans traxi mecum. Maria aspera iuro

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.352
passages.text: non ullum pro me tantum cepisse timorem,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.353
passages.text: quam tua ne, spoliata armis, excussa magistro,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.354
passages.text: deficeret tantis navis surgentibus undis.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.355
passages.text: Tris Notus hibernas immensa per aequora noctes

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.356
passages.text: vexit me violentus aqua; vix lumine quarto

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.357
passages.text: prospexi Italiam summa sublimis ab unda.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.358
passages.text: Paulatim adnabam terrae; iam tuta tenebam,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.359
passages.text: ni gens crudelis madida cum veste gravatum

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.360
passages.text: prensantemque uncis manibus capita aspera montis

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.361
passages.text: ferro invasisset, praedamque ignara putasset.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.362
passages.text: Nunc me fluctus habet, versantque in litore venti.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.363
passages.text: Quod te per caeli iucundum lumen et auras,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.364
passages.text: per genitorem oro, per spes surgentis Iuli,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.365
passages.text: eripe me his, invicte, malis: aut tu mihi terram

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.366
passages.text: inice, namque potes, portusque require Velinos;

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.367
passages.text: aut tu, si qua via est, si quam tibi diva creatrix

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.368
passages.text: ostendit—neque enim, credo, sine numine divom

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.369
passages.text: flumina tanta paras Stygiamque innare paludem—

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.370
passages.text: da dextram misero, et tecum me tolle per undas,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.371
passages.text: sedibus ut saltem placidis in morte quiescam.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.372
passages.text: Talia fatus erat, coepit cum talia vates:

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.373
passages.text: Unde haec, o Palinure, tibi tam dira cupido?

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.374
passages.text: Tu Stygias inhumatus aquas amnemque severum

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.375
passages.text: Eumenidum aspicies, ripamve iniussus adibis?

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.376
passages.text: Desine fata deum flecti sperare precando.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.377
passages.text: Sed cape dicta memor, duri solatia casus.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.378
passages.text: Nam tua finitimi, longe lateque per urbes

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.379
passages.text: prodigiis acti caelestibus, ossa piabunt,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.380
passages.text: et statuent tumulum, et tumulo sollemnia mittent,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.381
passages.text: aeternumque locus Palinuri nomen habebit.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.382
passages.text: His dictis curae emotae, pulsusque parumper

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.383
passages.text: corde dolor tristi: gaudet cognomine terrae.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.384
passages.text: Ergo iter inceptum peragunt fluvioque propinquant.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.385
passages.text: Navita quos iam inde ut Stygia prospexit ab unda

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.386
passages.text: per tacitum nemus ire pedemque advertere ripae,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.387
passages.text: sic prior adgreditur dictis, atque increpat ultro:

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.388
passages.text: Quisquis es, armatus qui nostra ad flumina tendis,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.389
passages.text: fare age, quid venias, iam istinc, et comprime gressum.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.390
passages.text: Umbrarum hic locus est, somni noctisque soporae;

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.391
passages.text: corpora viva nefas Stygia vectare carina.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.392
passages.text: Nec vero Alciden me sum laetatus euntem

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.393
passages.text: accepisse lacu, nec Thesea Pirithoumque,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.394
passages.text: dis quamquam geniti atque invicti viribus essent.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.395
passages.text: Tartareum ille manu custodem in vincla petivit,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.396
passages.text: ipsius a solio regis, traxitque trementem;

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.397
passages.text: hi dominam Ditis thalamo deducere adorti.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.398
passages.text: Quae contra breviter fata est Amphrysia vates:

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.399
passages.text: Nullae hic insidiae tales; absiste moveri;

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.400
passages.text: nec vim tela ferunt; licet ingens ianitor antro

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.401
passages.text: aeternum latrans exsanguis terreat umbras,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.402
passages.text: casta licet patrui servet Proserpina limen.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.403
passages.text: Troius Aeneas, pietate insignis et armis,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.404
passages.text: ad genitorem imas Erebi descendit ad umbras.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.405
passages.text: Si te nulla movet tantae pietatis imago,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.406
passages.text: at ramum hunc (aperit ramum, qui veste latebat)

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.407
passages.text: adgnoscas. Tumida ex ira tum corda residunt.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.408
passages.text: Nec plura his. Ille admirans venerabile donum

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.409
passages.text: fatalis virgae, longo post tempore visum,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.410
passages.text: caeruleam advertit puppim, ripaeque propinquat.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.411
passages.text: Inde alias animas, quae per iuga longa sedebant,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.412
passages.text: deturbat, laxatque foros; simul accipit alveo

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.413
passages.text: ingentem Aenean. Gemuit sub pondere cymba

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.414
passages.text: sutilis, et multam accepit rimosa paludem.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.415
passages.text: Tandem trans fluvium incolumis vatemque virumque

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.416
passages.text: informi limo glaucaque exponit in ulva.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.417
passages.text: Cerberus haec ingens latratu regna trifauci

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.418
passages.text: personat, adverso recubans immanis in antro.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.419
passages.text: Cui vates, horrere videns iam colla colubris,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.420
passages.text: melle soporatam et medicatis frugibus offam

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.421
passages.text: obicit. Ille fame rabida tria guttura pandens

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.422
passages.text: corripit obiectam, atque immania terga resolvit

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.423

passages.text: Excudent alii spirantia mollius aera,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.848
passages.text: credo equidem, vivos ducent de marmore voltus,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.849
passages.text: orabunt causas melius, caelique meatus

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.850
passages.text: describent radio, et surgentia sidera dicent:

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.851
passages.text: tu regere imperio populos, Romane, memento;

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.852
passages.text: hae tibi erunt artes; pacisque imponere morem,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.853
passages.text: parcere subiectis, et debellare superbos.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.854
passages.text: Sic pater Anchises, atque haec mirantibus addit:

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.855
passages.text: Aspice, ut insignis spoliis Marcellus opimis

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.856
passages.text: ingreditur, victorque viros supereminet omnes!

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.857
passages.text: Hic rem Romanam, magno turbante tumultu,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.858
passages.text: sistet, eques sternet Poenos Gallumque rebellem,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.859
passages.text: tertiaque arma patri suspendet capta Quirino.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.860
passages.text: Atque hic Aeneas; una namque ire videbat

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.861
passages.text: egregium forma iuvenem et fulgentibus armis,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.862
passages.text: sed frons laeta parum, et deiecto lumina voltu:

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.863
passages.text: Quis, pater, ille, virum qui sic comitatur euntem?

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.864
passages.text: Filius, anne aliquis magna de stirpe nepotum?

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.865
passages.text: Quis strepitus circa comitum! Quantum instar in ipso!

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.866
passages.text: Sed nox atra caput tristi circumvolat umbra.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.867
passages.text: Tum pater Anchises, lacrimis ingressus obortis:

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.868
passages.text: O gnate, ingentem luctum ne quaere tuorum;

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.869
passages.text: ostendent terris hunc tantum fata, neque ultra

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.870
passages.text: esse sinent. Nimium vobis Romana propago

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.871
passages.text: visa potens, Superi, propria haec si dona fuissent.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.872
passages.text: Quantos ille virum magnam Mavortis ad urbem

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.873
passages.text: campus aget gemitus, vel quae, Tiberine, videbis

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.874
passages.text: funera, cum tumulum praeterlabere recentem!

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.875
passages.text: Nec puer Iliaca quisquam de gente Latinos

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.876
passages.text: in tantum spe tollet avos, nec Romula quondam

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.877
passages.text: ullo se tantum tellus iactabit alumno.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.878
passages.text: Heu pietas, heu prisca fides, invictaque bello

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.879
passages.text: dextera! Non illi se quisquam impune tulisset

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.880
passages.text: obvius armato, seu cum pedes iret in hostem,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.881
passages.text: seu spumantis equi foderet calcaribus armos.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.882
passages.text: Heu, miserande puer, si qua fata aspera rumpas,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.883
passages.text: tu Marcellus eris. Manibus date lilia plenis,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.884
passages.text: purpureos spargam flores, animamque nepotis

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.885
passages.text: his saltem adcumulem donis, et fungar inani

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.886
passages.text: munere—Sic tota passim regione vagantur

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.887
passages.text: aëris in campis latis, atque omnia lustrant.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.888
passages.text: Quae postquam Anchises natum per singula duxit,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.889
passages.text: incenditque animum famae venientis amore,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.890
passages.text: exin bella viro memorat quae deinde gerenda,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.891
passages.text: Laurentisque docet populos urbemque Latini,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.892
passages.text: et quo quemque modo fugiatque feratque laborem.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.893
passages.text: Sunt geminae Somni portae, quarum altera fertur

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.894
passages.text: cornea, qua veris facilis datur exitus umbris;

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.895
passages.text: altera candenti perfecta nitens elephanto,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.896
passages.text: sed falsa ad caelum mittunt insomnia Manes.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.897
passages.text: His ubi tum natum Anchises unaque Sibyllam

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.898
passages.text: prosequitur dictis, portaque emittit eburna,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.899
passages.text: ille viam secat ad naves sociosque revisit:

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 6.900
passages.text: tum se ad Caietae recto fert litore portum.
